Class AetherisNotebookPanel.SnappedHeader

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.AetherisNotebookPanel.SnappedHeader
All Implemented Interfaces:
LayoutManager
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
private static final class AetherisNotebookPanel.SnappedHeader extends Object implements LayoutManager
The class SnappedHeader stacks the facts panel and then the width-control panel. The inspector adds those two children in that order. This layout inserts no gap of its own between children. The preferred width is 0, so the header does not widen the split. A hidden child is skipped. addLayoutComponent(String, Component) and removeLayoutComponent(Component) do nothing.

    • span

      private static int span(Container target)
      The method returns the width used to measure the stack. A parent wider than 0 wins. Otherwise the target width wins when it is wider than 0. Otherwise the result is 0.
      Parameters:
      target - The target is the header container.
      Returns:
      The return value is that width in pixels.

    • stackHeight

      private static int stackHeight(Container target, int width)
      The method sums childHeight(Component, int) for every visible child. A hidden child adds nothing.
      Parameters:
      target - The target is the header container.
      width - The width is the column width passed to each child.
      Returns:
      The return value is the sum in pixels.

    • childHeight

      private static int childHeight(Component child, int width)
      The method returns the height of one header child. A AetherisNotebookPanel.SnappedFlow uses AetherisNotebookPanel.SnappedFlow.heightAt(int). Any other child uses its preferred height. A null preferred size returns 0.
      Parameters:
      child - The child is the component being measured.
      width - The width is the column width offered to a AetherisNotebookPanel.SnappedFlow.
      Returns:
      The return value is that height in pixels.
